forbidden.title: Managers only
forbidden.body: Only a manager of this business administers its users. Ask your manager if you need a change.

emptyState.title: No users yet
emptyState.description: Invite the first colleague — they choose their own password through the invitation.

emptyFilteredState.title: No matches
emptyFilteredState.description: No user matches the current search or status.

rowMenu.resendInvitationDisabled: Only a user who has not accepted their invitation yet
rowMenu.suspendDisabledNotActive: Only an active user can be suspended
rowMenu.editDisabledDeactivated: A deactivated user is not edited — reactivate first

actions.resendFailed: The invitation could not be sent.
actions.statusFailed: The status could not be changed.
actions.handOverFailed: Not everything could be handed over — {{groups}}. Those records stay with this person for now; "Hand over open records" tries again.
actions.handOverFailedAfterDeactivation: Deactivated, but not everything could be handed over — {{groups}}. Those records stay with this person for now; "Hand over open records" in the row menu tries again.
actions.validToCleared: {{name}} is active again. The expired access end ({{date}}) was removed — set a new one under "Edit" if needed.

form.conflict: This user was changed in the meantime. Close the dialog and open it again.

fields.emailLocked: An active user's address is changed by Nexotec support (account recovery).
fields.managerHint: Administers users, settings and integrations. The business always keeps at least one active manager.
fields.managerSelfHint: Your own manager flag is changed by another manager.
fields.delegationsHint: Delegation per category; the manager can always edit them.
fields.validToHint: After this day the access ends automatically and open records go to the queue.
fields.signatureHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB — printed on documents the user signs.
fields.photoHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB — shown beside the name in the user list.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}
deactivate.intro: Access ends now. Everything this person still looks after is handed over below — to a colleague or to the module's queue (drafts without a seller are found on the customer). Nothing is deleted; history keeps the original author.
deactivate.nothingOpen: Nothing open in any of the {{modules, number}} modules.
deactivate.ownershipLoadError: What this user owns could not be loaded.
deactivate.incomplete: The hand-over is not complete yet:

problems.undecided: {{what}}: needs a decision — a colleague, or "Leave unassigned".
problems.not_owned: {{what}}: this person does not (or no longer) look after these.
problems.self: {{what}}: the person cannot take over their own records.
problems.colleague_not_active: {{what}}: the chosen colleague is not an active user of this business.
problems.colleague_cannot_act_there: {{what}}: {{count, number}} of these belong to another business the chosen colleague does not work in — choose "Leave unassigned" (that business hands them over from its queue) or a colleague who is a member there.
problems.other: {{what}}: this group cannot be handed over as chosen — choose again.

handOver.title: Hand over {{name}}'s open records
handOver.intro: What this person still looks after is handed to a colleague or to the module's queue — also after a deactivation in which a module could not complete the hand-over.

errors.lastManager: A business always needs at least one active manager — the last one can be neither deactivated nor demoted.
errors.lastManagerElsewhere: This person is the last active manager of another business they are a member of — they can be suspended or deactivated once that business has another manager.

failureReason.module_failed: the module could not complete the hand-over; details are in the log
failureReason.colleague_cannot_act_there: the colleague does not work in every business involved

memberships.noneYouManage: Only businesses you are a manager of yourself are listed here. Access to other businesses is not shown to you.
memberships.notYours: You are not a manager of this business, so you cannot change access to it.
memberships.failed: The access could not be changed. Please try again.
